attchmntText: DCM Shriram Fine Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation regarding change in the Corporate Office of the Registrar and Share Transfer Agent (RTA) of the Company with effect from December 01, 2026.'.
voiceSummary: DCM Shriram Fine Chemicals Limited intimates that its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, KFin Technologies Limited, is changing its corporate office address effective December 01, 2026. The previous address at Selenium Tower B, Plot No. 31 and 32, Gachibowli, Financial District, Nanakramguda, Serilingampally, Hyderabad, 500032, Telangana, will be replaced. The new corporate office address is 6, 23, 24, and 25th Floor, South Tower, Rajapushpa West Avenue, Survey No. 115, Kokapet, Serilingampally Mandal, Ranga Reddy District, Telangana, 500075. Contact details include telephone number 081210 13657, email statutoryandcompliance@kfintech.com, and website https://www.kfintech.com/. The company confirms there is no change in the name of the RTA, its registered office, or its appointment as Registrar and Share Transfer Agent.

attchmntText: DCM Shriram Fine Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Amendment to AOA/MOA of the company.
voiceSummary: DCM Shriram Fine Chemicals Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone net sales were Rs. 8,878.18 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 17,896.54 lakhs for the six months. Consolidated net sales were Rs. 8,878.18 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 17,896.54 lakhs for the six months. Standalone net profit was Rs. 3.41 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 245.05 lakhs for the six months. Consolidated net loss was Rs. 7.65 lakhs for the quarter and net profit was Rs. 251.70 lakhs for the six months. The Board appointed Mr. Ashwini Shanker as Additional Director, subject to shareholder approval via postal ballot. The Articles of Association alteration is also subject to shareholder approval via postal ballot.
